Name: Orangeblossom's Vintage Chic Interiors
Author: orangeblossom7
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][center][color=#9fc5e8][size=6][b]Vintage Chic Interiors[/b][/size][/color]
[i]by orangeblossom[/i][/center]

[i]This is how I envisioned Too Many Swatches II to look, I just didn't have the skills to achieve it the first time I made it. [/i](ᵕ—ᴗ—)


[center][color=#fce5cd]﻿~ ✿ ~ ✿ ~ ﻿✿ ~[/color][/center]

Hello, I'm back with another furniture set! This time, it's a reimagined and cp-fied version of my old Too Many Swatches II mod. ♡


[b][color=#9fc5e8]DETAILS:[/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]contains furniture and wallpaper & flooring[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]6 swatches (main: french blue; optional: alabaster, pistachio, rose quartz, cape honey, aquamarine)[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]1 wood (furniture); 2 woods (wallpaper and flooring)[/font]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][i]note: [/i][i]please don't delete the main mod (french blue). you can delete any of the optional colors though :D[/i] 


[b][color=#9fc5e8]REQUIREMENTS:[/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Content Patcher[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Calcifer[/font]
[/list][font=Times New Roman]

[b][color=#9fc5e8]WHERE TO FIND:[/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Robin's Shop for 50,000g (for the furniture)[/font]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Pierre's Store (from the catalogue) for 30,000g (for the wallpaper and flooring)[/font]
[/list][font=Times New Roman][i]note: alternatively, you can also use CJB item spawner.[/i] 


[font=Times New Roman][b][color=#9fc5e8]MODS USED IN THE SCREENSHOTS:[/color][/b]
